responsibility: Implements the core behavior of GCC’s vrange class hierarchy, including generic vrange operations, Value_Range wrappers, visitor dispatch, dumping, and key irange/frange methods such as type support, union/intersection defaults, denormal flushing, NaN-aware floating setters, and canonicalization logic. It is the central runtime support file for the concrete range objects manipulated by ranger, VRP, CCP, threading, and range operators, and it maintains representation-level invariants that downstream range queries and optimization passes rely on.
same_name_distinction: Contains the out-of-line behavior for the range types declared in value-range.h, including vrange dispatch, dumping through value-range-pretty-print, default operations, and core irange/frange method bodies. It is the implementation companion to the header’s type and inline API definitions. Unlike tree-vrp.cc, gimple-range.cc, and vr-values.cc, this file is not a pass driver or query engine; it is the shared range-object representation and invariant layer used by those clients.
